Title: SQL injection in ticket search
Significance: Untrusted search text was concatenated into SQL; injection could alter query behavior (OWASP A05:2025 Injection).
Resolution: Replaced concatenation with JdbcTemplate bind parameters and escaped LIKE wildcards; added injection regression tests.

Title: Sensitive ticket data written to logs
Significance: Logging the full Ticket record exposed requester email and access token in logs (OWASP A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration / sensitive logging concern).
Resolution: Log only ticket id, category, and status; never log the Ticket object or token.

Title: Internal exception details returned to clients
Significance: Raw exception and cause disclosed implementation details and could expose sensitive diagnostic information (OWASP A10:2025 Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions).
Resolution: Added centralized exception handling with safe 400/404/500 responses; full unexpected details remain server-side only.

Title: Missing validation of ticket input
Significance: Blank/invalid/unbounded values could enter the application and create poor data or resource-abuse conditions.
Resolution: Added required-field, email, category, and length validation plus boundary/invalid tests.

Title: Unchecked ticket status and missing target handling
Significance: Enum parsing could throw an uncontrolled exception and an update could appear successful for a missing ticket.
Resolution: Verify ticket exists and validate status before update; added parameterized invalid-status tests.

Title: H2 database console enabled
Significance: Development database console was enabled even though the application does not require it, increasing exposed attack surface (OWASP A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration).
Resolution: Disabled H2 console and disabled error message/stacktrace inclusion.

Title: Insufficient automated coverage
Significance: Starter tests covered only three happy-path service cases and did not exercise boundaries, invalid input, injection, or user workflows.
Resolution: Expanded unit, repository security, parameterized, boundary, and end-to-end HTTP workflow tests.
